component.name: opencal
component.summary: Local calendar and task manager with command-based sync

description.p: opencal is a calendar and to-do list that keeps everything on your computer, in a plain iCalendar (.ics) file. There are no online accounts. To share the calendar between computers, opencal runs your own pull and push commands (rclone, scp, git, curl, a script) and merges the two copies, keeping additions, edits, deletions and completed tasks from both sides.

ul.li: Day, week, month, agenda and task views
Repeating events, all-day and multi-day events, tasks with due dates and priorities
Drag to create, move and resize events
Import and export of iCalendar files
A C and Rust library (libopencal) for other programs
